name: volc-agent-launchpad
description: A middleware-free Agent platform starter kit running Codex CLI locally or on Volcengine ECS.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/web"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:replay -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchpad/contract && npm run build -w @launchpad/web && npm run build -w @launchpad/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @launchpad/contract && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @launchpad/contract && npm run test -w @launchpad/server && npm run test -w @launchpad/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke
